nodes.name: power_5v
nodes.description: TPS54331 buck converter steps down VIN_12V_24V to 5V logic rail. EN pin configured for always-on (connected to VIN). BOOT capacitor required, feedback VSENSE must connect to 5V rail via resistor divider. PH inductor required. This module is the sole provider of VCC_5V rail.

nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 LDO steps VCC_5V down to 3.3V MCU and peripheral rail. Input and output need bypass caps. This module is the sole provider of VCC_3V3 rail.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: STM32F103 MCU runs on 3.3V (VCC_3V3) and is master for the system. It communicates with TMC2209 drivers via UART (different addresses). One UART TX/RX pair per driver. Communicates with W25Q64JV Flash via SPI for motion parameter storage. BOOT0 configured for Flash boot mode. This module owns UART pull-up/configuration for TMC2209 PDN_UART pins and SPI pull-up/configuration.

nodes.name: driver_channel_a
nodes.description: TMC2209 stepper driver for channel A. Powered from motor supply VIN_12V_24V (VS pins) and logic rail VCC_5V (VCC_IO). Uses address pins MS1_AD0, MS2_AD1 to set UART slave address (must be configured via passive network distinct from channel B). PDN_UART must be pulled up via resistor to enable UART mode. VREF uses potentiometer to set current reference. STEP, DIR, ENN (ENN pin must be driven inverted from MCU enable signal) for basic control. DIAG open-drain output for fault reporting. Motor outputs OA1, OA2, OB1, OB2 connect to motor coils. This module is the sole provider of motor power rail to motor A.

nodes.name: flash
nodes.description: W25Q64JV SPI Flash memory for motion parameter storage. Operates on VCC_3V3. HOLD pin pulled high via resistor to disable hold function. WP pin pulled high via resistor to disable write protection. CS pin driven by MCU SPI_CS_FLASH. SPI bus lines shared with MCU.

nodes.name: WP
nodes.description: Write Protect, active low (IO2 in Quad mode). Tie to VCC for normal operation.

nodes.name: HOLD
nodes.description: Hold/Reset, active low (IO3 in Quad mode). Tie to VCC for normal operation.
